items.quote: For the LORD had said unto Moses, Say unto the children of Israel, Ye are a stiffnecked people:
items.claim: The text says the LORD told Moses to tell the children of Israel that they are a stiffnecked people.
items.mechanism: divine speech passed on through Moses

items.quote: I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee:
items.claim: The text says the LORD threatened to come into the midst of the Israelites in a moment and consume them.

items.quote: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do unto thee.
items.claim: The text says the Israelites were ordered to take off their ornaments so that the LORD could decide what to do with them.
items.mechanism: removing ornaments as a sign of submission, with the LORD's judgment put off until later
